title: Standing authorizations
description: Permissions you have granted for future tasks on specific computers and directories. Ask Persona in the main conversation to add one.
footer: Revoking a grant stops its use for future tasks and approvals. It cannot undo work or instructions already delivered. Action reversibility describes the authorized work; every grant can be revoked here.
source_suggested_rule: Suggested rule: the same answer {n} times in 14 days, confirmed with Always.
reversible: Can the authorized actions be undone?
empty: No standing authorizations. Tasks still follow their usual approval process.
load_failed: Couldn't load standing authorizations. Check the connection and refresh.
forbidden: Full access is required to view and revoke standing authorizations.
confirm_effect: This permanently removes the grant. Future tasks and approvals will no longer use it. Work and instructions already delivered are unaffected. To grant it again, ask Persona in the main conversation.
delete_failed: Couldn't revoke this authorization. It is still listed. Check the connection and retry; if it was already removed, retrying is safe.
